description: Fallback for ONE moment get_annotated_frames did not show: the exact frame at a recording time (at) or when a word/phrase was spoken (word). get_annotated_frames already shows every [phrase](#rt=S) link in a comment - call it first; use this for a moment the comment doesn't link (something the transcript mentions) or a link it named as not shown. Returns the asset frame at that moment (plus the active shared screen, if any) and a transcript snippet around it. Each frame comes with a Link to it as shown (drawing included) and, when different, Media only (the same moment without the drawing or pointer): addresses any tool can fetch, no login, for some hours. Download them or pass them to another tool (an image or video model); call again for fresh links.

at.description: recording time in seconds (a moment the transcript mentions, or a link get_annotated_frames named as not shown)

element_id.description: The recording feedback item (element) to drill into

source.description: limit to the asset frame or the shared-screen frame

word.description: a word or short phrase the reviewer spoke

name: get_frame
title: Get frame
